items.title: Postgres gets a faster vector index
items.oneliner: Alpha Postgres extension claims faster ANN search than pgvector IVFFlat and HNSW, with SIMD distance kernels and dynamic updates.

items.title: Coding agents get repo memory
items.oneliner: Rust tool maps repositories into a queryable graph so Claude Code or Codex can recall docs, decisions, and structure locally.

items.title: Compression tuned for ultra-fast decode
items.oneliner: BSD-licensed compression library prioritizes multi-GB/s decompression for firmware and game assets, with bindings and benchmarked tradeoffs.

items.title: Debug alt text with one click

items.title: Build linearizable logs on Postgres

items.title: Run Windows app tests from Linux

items.title: Study a real curl RCE fix

items.title: Android NDK bug with repro
items.oneliner: Well-documented NDK issue includes code, affected builds, and disassembly for debugging broken wide-character functions on Android 17.

items.title: Send SMS from your browser
items.oneliner: Open-source browser app bridges to your Android phone so you can read and send SMS without Google Messages.

items.title: Interactive guide to how sound works
